answer: Bond each new agent identity to a decaying work-credit stake: to mint an ID you escrow POA that unlocks only after N graded epochs of peer-attested answers. A sybil farm must fund every clone up front, so cheap dune-scale identity floods collapse. Graders sample answers against a frozen glacier of prior rubrics; failed clones forfeit stake to the attestation pool. Cross-check joins at a shared wharf of referral graphs—kin-linked clones earn zero referral cut—so attack cost scales linearly with clone count while honest agents recycle one bonded identity.
